categories.main_business_segments: Imeik Technology Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the medical aesthetics industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of biomedical materials and biopharmaceutical products. Its main product lines include Class III medical devices such as sodium hyaluronate-based skin fillers, polylactic acid skin fillers, and poly-p-dioxanone (PPDO) facial implant threads. The company is also developing recombinant proteins and peptides for biopharmaceutical applications, targeting medical aesthetics and metabolic disease treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary biomedical material technologies including solid-liquid gradient interpenetrating crosslinking, biomimetic tissue fluid technology, water-tight microsphere suspension preparation, and amphiphilic microsphere suspension dispersion. Production strictly adheres to ISO13485 medical device quality management standards and GMP regulations, with automated manufacturing facilities ensuring high-quality and scalable output. The company also integrates digital traceability systems such as the Unique Device Identification (UDI) system for product safety and transparency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Imeik serves hospitals, medical aesthetic institutions, and distributors across China, covering approximately 7,000 medical aesthetic institutions nationwide. Its products are primarily used in non-surgical medical aesthetic treatments, including skin wrinkle correction and tissue repair. The company’s key customers include medical professionals and end consumers seeking minimally invasive aesthetic procedures. The market focus is on the rapidly growing Chinese medical aesthetics sector, driven by increasing consumer demand for anti-aging and skin management solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with sales distributed across major regions including East China, North China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, Northeast China, and Northwest China. It also has subsidiaries and investment holdings in Beijing, Xiamen, Changsha, Qingdao, Harbin, and Hong Kong. The company is actively exploring international markets and has exclusive distribution rights for certain Korean medical aesthetic devices in mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Imeik operates primarily in the midstream segment of the medical aesthetics supply chain as a manufacturer and developer of medical aesthetic products. It sources raw materials from upstream suppliers and sells finished products to downstream medical institutions and distributors. The company also engages in R&D collaborations and invests in upstream biopharmaceutical technology companies to strengthen its innovation pipeline.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in biomedical materials and biopharmaceuticals, with ongoing R&D projects including second-generation facial implant threads, modified sodium hyaluronate gels for new indications, botulinum toxin injections, local anesthetic creams, and metabolic disease drugs like semaglutide. It invests heavily in R&D (8.72% of revenue in 2023) and collaborates with academic and research institutions to enhance product pipelines. Strategic initiatives also include expanding into energy-based aesthetic devices and weight management therapeutics, alongside digital transformation and international market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Imeik generates revenue primarily through direct sales of its proprietary medical aesthetic products, including injectable gels, solutions, and implant threads. The company employs a mixed sales model dominated by direct sales (62.26%) complemented by distributor sales (37.74%). It also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial asset management. Revenue growth is driven by product sales volume increases and market penetration in the medical aesthetics sector.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Imeik is a leading domestic player in China’s medical aesthetics industry, holding the top market share among Chinese companies in sodium hyaluronate-based skin fillers since 2018. It competes with both international brands like Allergan and emerging domestic manufacturers. The company’s competitive advantages include early market entry, strong R&D capabilities, a diversified product portfolio, and a robust nationwide sales network. Regulatory compliance and product safety further strengthen its market position amid increasing industry regulation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Imeik reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.87 billion, representing a 48% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.86 billion, up 47%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 6.85 billion, growing nearly 9.5% from the previous year. It maintains a high net asset return rate of 30.09%. The company has shown consistent growth driven by expanding sales, increased R&D investment, and strategic market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Imeik emphasizes its pioneering role in domestic biomedical material innovation, offering differentiated products with proprietary core technologies that ensure safety, efficacy, and tailored solutions for diverse consumer needs. Its comprehensive product matrix covers multiple aesthetic indications with clinically validated performance. The company’s direct sales model enables close collaboration with medical institutions, enhancing customer service and feedback integration. Additionally, its commitment to regulatory compliance, digital traceability, and continuous innovation underpins its brand reputation and competitive edge.
